name: Plainstrider Scale
summary: Across Mulgore, Plainstrider Scale is sought for a remedy Maur Raincaller prepares in Bloodhoof Village. The tough scale helps counter a spreading infection.

sections.title: A Rare Ingredient
sections.body: Plainstriders roam Mulgore with tough scales covering their powerful legs. The scales protect them, though only some are firm enough to grind for folk remedies.

sections.title: A Remedy for a Venomous Bite
sections.body: Maur Raincaller in Bloodhoof Village was bitten in the shoulder by Mazzranache, a legendary strider with demonic red eyes and a venomous bite. The wound left Maur delirious with fever. To cleanse the spreading infection before it proves fatal, he needs a Plainstrider Scale, a wolf heart, a cougar femur, and a swoop gizzard.

faq.q: What is the Plainstrider Scale used for?
faq.answer: Maur Raincaller in Bloodhoof Village needs a Plainstrider Scale for a remedy. He combines it with parts from other Mulgore predators to treat the infected wound Mazzranache inflicted with its venomous bite.

faq.q: Where do you find a Plainstrider Scale?
faq.answer: You find Plainstrider Scales on wild plainstriders roaming Mulgore's open grasslands.
Maur Raincaller was bitten in the shoulder by Mazzranache, a tallstrider with crimson eyes and a venomous bite. The wound left him with a worsening fever and delirium.

faq.q: What other ingredients does Maur need for his remedy?
faq.answer: Maur needs a Plainstrider Scale, a Prairie Wolf Heart, a Flatland Cougar Femur, and a Swoop Gizzard for his remedy.

angles.text: As a Tauren, you learn to gather remedies from the land and use the plains' wildlife to sustain your tribe.
